title: Project 4 · Report the top customers
prompt: Leave out cancelled orders. For the five customers who have spent the most, return first_name, orders (how many orders they placed) and spent (the total of quantity * unit_price over the items of those orders). Put the highest spent first.
hints: After joining orders to their items, a row is one item. How do you count orders?
Total each order first, or count each order once. Then group by customer.
count(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders, sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS spent ... ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 5

wrongAnswers.misconception: Counts item rows and reports them as orders.
Includes cancelled orders in the totals.

feedback: Test the top customer with a plain query on orders alone: how many of their orders are not cancelled?
